vo_face_diamond_full_perimeter.evidence: Thumbnail view shows the entire hairline-to-chin outline; pinned hair leaves both temples, cheek edges, jaw corners, and chin readable.

vo_face_diamond_vertical_relation.evidence: Thumbnail and native views show full hairline-to-chin height beside the widest cheek span, with neither top nor chin cropped.

vo_face_diamond_zygomatic_width.evidence: At thumbnail and native scale, the bilateral cheekbone span is visibly wider than the temple-forehead span and much wider than the jaw corners.

vo_face_diamond_two_direction_taper.evidence: Native view shows the contour narrowing upward from the cheekbones toward the temples and downward through the jaw to a small chin.

vo_face_diamond_confound_control.evidence: Native view shows an actual frontal perimeter with hair pulled back; earrings, makeup, highlights, and lens perspective do not create the lateral-width hierarchy.
